name: Microsoft Fabric Migration
title: Migration vers Microsoft Fabric
subtitle: From Azure legacy + Databricks to Microsoft Fabric
description: Migration d'une plateforme data existante basée sur Azure legacy et Databricks vers Microsoft Fabric, avec refonte de l'ingestion, du stockage, des transformations, de l'exposition métier et de la gouvernance data.
impact: Modernisation d'une architecture data existante vers une plateforme unifiée, gouvernée et prête pour les usages BI et data engineering.
scope: Lakehouse, semantic model and business exposure

name: Audit ML Forecasting
title: Prediction of audit closing dates
subtitle: Machine learning for audit planning
description: Trained and deployed a regression model to predict action plan realization duration from structured audit data.
impact: Helped audit teams anticipate delivery timelines and prioritize follow-up actions with clearer planning signals.
imageAlt: Regression model visualization for audit closing date prediction

name: Topic Identification
title: Topic identification
subtitle: NLP classification for audit action plans
description: Classified action plans by analyzing recommendation and issue description text to identify recurring themes.
impact: Improved portfolio-level visibility into recurring audit topics and reduced manual review effort.
imageAlt: Text classification visual for topic identification

name: Fraud and Anomaly Detection
title: Fraud & anomaly detection
subtitle: Statistics and unsupervised ML
description: Built a tool leveraging statistics and machine learning to detect unusual patterns in travel and expenses data.
impact: Surfaced suspicious behavior faster and gave reviewers a more focused anomaly investigation workflow.

name: RAG Interaction System
title: RAG-enabled interaction system
subtitle: Azure OpenAI retrieval assistant
description: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation tool using Azure OpenAI, ChromaDB and Streamlit, enabling auditors to interact with audit reports.
impact: Made long audit reports easier to query, summarize and reuse through a guided conversational interface.
imageAlt: RAG application interface and retrieval workflow

name: Live Data Chatbot
title: Live data chatbot
subtitle: Natural language over Databricks SQL
description: Developed a chatbot to interact with structured data in Databricks SQL Warehouse. The system dynamically queries based on user questions and retrieves information.
impact: Reduced friction between business questions and governed warehouse data by making exploration conversational.
imageAlt: Chatbot interface for structured data analysis

name: Power BI Reporting Solutions
title: Power BI reporting solutions
subtitle: Semantic models and dashboards
description: Delivered end-to-end Power BI reports for audit, merger and acquisitions, finance, accounting, green offer and sustainability teams.
impact: Turned operational data into decision-ready dashboards with cleaner models, measures and reporting workflows.
imageAlt: Power BI and data visualization dashboard
